iti36:1.1: (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti36:2.1: Nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati jana kuhanatthaṃ janalapanatthaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ iti maṃ jano jānātū-ti. Atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati abhiññatthañceva pariññatthañcā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti36:3.1: Abhiññatthaṃ pariññatthaṃ brahmacariyaṃ anītihaṃ | adesayī so bhagavā nibbānogadhagāminaṃ ||
iti36:4.1: Esa maggo mahattehi anuyāto mahesino | ye ye taṃ paṭipajjanti yathā buddhena desitaṃ | dukkhassantaṃ karissanti satthusāsanakārino ti ||
iti36:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9||
